sites.tag_type: DogTag peptide with GGGGS flanking linkers
sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.rationale: This is the sole ledger-supported site for TRPC5. Computed sequence confirms seq[459]='Y' and seq[460]='N', exactly matching the paper's stated Y460|N461 junction. The site is extracellular (ECL3, topology 455–476), ≥3 residues from both TM boundaries, and was used in a published full-length, cell-surface-displayed construct. No terminal sites are available: the N-terminus (1–327) and C-terminus (625–973) are both intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks. ECL1 (338–338) is a single residue and cannot accommodate an insert. ECL4 (536–603) contains C553 and C558 (likely a disulfide pair) and has no ledger evidence. ECL2 (385–404) has no ledger evidence. Therefore only this one site is reported. [validation: surface_and_function; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: For pcDNA4-TRPC5-DogTag-SYFP2, DogTag (underlined), flanked by a glycine-serine linkers (GGGGS DIPATYEFTDGKHYITNEPIPPK GGGGS) was introduced between Y460 and N461 of human TRPC5 by site-directed mutagenesis with Q5 High-Fidelity DNA polymerase (NEB).
